candidates.tagline: They tried to fire Uncle Herschel. Now the CEO is fired instead.
candidates.story: Cracker Barrel unveiled a sleek new logo in August 2025, quietly dropping the beloved 'Uncle Herschel' mascot leaning on a barrel — lasted six days before mass backlash, a Trump post, and a 7% same-store sales plunge; the CEO who ordered the change now steps down.
candidates.why_funny: The only thing that got fired was the CEO — Uncle Herschel is still on every sign.
candidates.alt: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store exterior porch and sign showing the classic logo with a silhouette of a man in overalls leaning on a barrel

candidates.tagline: Sony killed the disc. Sony also just launched a vinyl turntable.
candidates.story: Sony announced physical PlayStation game disc production ends January 2028 — despite 82% of PS5 consoles sold having disc drives — while simultaneously unveiling a Sony Electronics vinyl turntable for music fans who love physical media.
candidates.why_funny: Sony supports physical media in exactly one format: the one PlayStation doesn't use.
candidates.alt: Open PS4 game cases with physical Blu-ray discs visible for The Witcher: Wild Hunt and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, surrounded by more physical game cases
